subject: Q3 timing check — any shift in priority / approval path for Cortex Health?
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@cortexhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery — Cortex / Redwood

Hi Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and agreed next steps so we have the same page: 

- What we heard: Cortex Health is focused on extracting structured insights from clinical notes for your quality improvement program. Primary constraints are PHI controls, predictability of latency for clinician-facing flows, and staying within an approved monthly budget for inference.
- What we showed: Redwood hosted + private deployment options, examples of latency profiles for short chat flows, and prefix caching to reduce cost on repeated templates.
- What's important to you: SOC2 / VPC options + a deterministic SLA for 95th percentile latency.

Proposed next steps (from our side):
1) We will share a short technical note on private deployment networking and KMS integration (attached: redwood-demo.pdf).
2) Rishi will draft an outline for a scoped pilot (3 months, X throughput estimate).
3) Monica will coordinate a 1-hour architecture review with your infra team next week.

Can you confirm: is the procurement timeline still planning for a Q3 decision (end of September)? Also — who else on your side should be looped into the architecture call (security or procurement contacts)?

If it helps, I've attached the demo notes and an example SOW template. Happy to adjust timing if budget approvals are shifting.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.g@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-demo.pdf (PDF), Cortex_SOW_v1.docx (DOCX)
From: Priya Sharma <priya@cortexhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery — Cortex / Redwood

Thanks Sean — appreciate the clear notes.

Short update on procurement: we're still finalizing our annual cloud budget and there may be a slight shift toward prioritizing infrastructure spend for a separate data-migration project. I'm still optimistic we can tee up a pilot conversation for Q3, but I need to confirm with finance this week.

For the architecture call, please include our security lead (Aaron Li) and procurement (purchasing@cortexhealth.com). Aaron's calendar is tight but he can do a 45-min window the week of Aug 11.

I'll confirm by Friday whether the Q3 timeline is locked or if it slips to early Q4.

— Priya
Director, Data & Analytics | Cortex Health
priya@cortexhealth.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Aug 2025 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — architecture call availability + pilot outline

Hi Priya — looping back as we haven't locked a time yet. Sean and I drafted a short pilot outline (attached in the previous email) that would keep spend under your stated target by using prefix caching and a smaller reserved pool for the first 90 days. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you confirm whether Aaron (security) prefers an internal-only walkthrough or would you like Redwood's infra eng to join?
2) Is procurement (purchasing@cortexhealth.com) the correct channel to send a pilot SOW, or should we route it through your legal team first?

If helpful, we can be flexible on the week of Aug 11 — we have morning slots available Tue/Wed (8/12 or 8/13) PST. If Q3 is at risk, flag that and we'll prioritize a compressed pilot approach that gets you to production gating decisions faster.

Thanks — Rishi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Subject: End-of-quarter check-in — priority still Q3 / any approval path changes?

Hi Priya — quick nudge as we close the week. Hope your budget conversations went well. Two quick questions to understand next steps: 

- Has finance indicated whether Cortex is keeping the Q3 decision target, or should we plan for early Q4?
- If the timeline shifts, is the blocker primarily budget reallocation or an approvals routing change (e.g., new stakeholder sign-off required)?

If it's helpful, we can:
- Share a condensed pilot statement of work (2 pages) that you can route to procurement for quick sign-off, or
- Offer a short commercial flexibility note (60-day trial + delayed billing) to give you breathing room while approvals land.

Either way, a one-line update helps us prioritize resources on our side — do you have a minute to reply here or should I reach out to Purchasing directly?

Appreciate it — Sean
